sources.title: Choose what to translate
sources.description: Add the subtitles you want translated. Folders, individual files, and archives all work.

options.title: Set the language and glossary
options.description: Every file below shows exactly where its translation will be written.
options.contextPlaceholder: Domain or tone guidance for the translation
options.glossaryHint: One entry per line, as "source = target" or "source -> target".

mode.label: Output
mode.suffix: New file with a language suffix
mode.replaceNote: A backup copy is made first when backups are enabled in Settings.

options.overwriteHint: Turn this on to re-include files whose translated output already exists.
options.terminologyNote: Translating also sends one extra request per file to extract consistent terminology.

report.title: Results
report.cancelled: You stopped the batch, so the remaining files were not started.
